title: fail-fast startup secretx resolution: all daemons resolve at startup not at request time
description: All secretx URIs are resolved before the server binds and accepts connections. A misconfigured or unavailable secret causes process::exit(1) at startup rather than a runtime failure on the first request that needs the credential. This is the correct tradeoff for a server daemon: predictable startup failure > intermittent runtime error. A future contributor might suggest lazy resolution to avoid the AWS SM round-trip at startup — do not do this.
